limitations: The asymptotics are pointwise for fixed shape and fixed nonzero asymmetry. No uniform transition theory as the shape approaches either critical value is proved, and no extension to general non-variance-gamma generalized hyperbolic medians is claimed. The 2001 generalized-Laplace monograph remains a residual originality risk.
provenance: Scientific record retained after a completed independent mathematical audit dated 2026-10-01 UTC.
record_title: Sharp large-noise asymptotics for variance-gamma medians
